ModMetadata.Name: Stationeers UI Ascended
ModMetadata.Author: FlorpyDorp + JXSN
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Stationeers UI Ascended[/h1]
A radial inventory and HUD overhaul for Stationeers, built around a two-hand visor interface: procedural Unity UGUI radials for tools/bags/equipment, SmartStow+, a document-driven visor HUD with per-profile themes, and the Universal Inventory. Client-side optional mod. [h3]Two curated HUD themes ship in the box — Stationeers Blue and Pure HUD — fully editable in-game with the F9 HUD Designer[/h3]
ModMetadata.InGameDescription:
Stationeers UI Ascended WARNING: This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad.
Stationeers UI Ascended — Radials for tools/bags/equipment, SmartStow+, the Universal Inventory, and a two-hand visor HUD. Replaces hotbar friction with modern interaction while keeping the game's own physical inventory rules.

The visor HUD is a document-driven layout you can reshape live in the F9 HUD Designer: move/resize/restyle any element, fork a look per suit tier, and save it as your own profile. Radials, the Universal Inventory and the Control Center menu all retint together with whichever profile theme is active. Two curated themes ship by default: Stationeers Blue and Pure HUD.
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: [h3]Version 0.9.7.1 EXPERIMENTAL -- CRITICAL public-branch fix + play-test round:[/h3] [list] [*] CRITICAL: fixed a crash loop on the DEFAULT (public) game branch -- a beta-branch field rename made the Universal Inventory throw every frame on public builds, which killed the Grid and starved the radials (the "cardboard box won't open" / "radial menu empty" reports). The mod now detects the game's field shape at runtime and works on BOTH branches [*] Body bags are no longer storage anywhere in the mod: no organ access via radials, the Universal Inventory, search or SmartStow. Vanilla interactions (cryotube revival) are untouched, and the after-death cardboard box still opens normally [*] Compass: North no longer reads ~10 degrees off when approached from below 360 -- the tick strip, cardinal letters and degree readout now agree at the wrap on every profile (including custom ones) [*] Fixed the main menu's "Exit To Desktop" confirmation being unclickable after leaving a dedicated server (a leaked item tooltip left a shared vanilla UI layer's clicks disabled) [/list] [h3]Version 0.9.7.0 EXPERIMENTAL -- SMARTSTOW PROFILES + F9 STYLE PARITY:[/h3] [list] [*] SMARTSTOW PROFILES, REBUILT: bag-routing rules are now organized into "Stow Profiles" -- switchable folders of "Bag Profiles" you can browse, copy between and share. F10's Storage tab is now four clear pages: Bags (card grid, live thumbnails, per-bag exclude + rename), Bag Profiles (the rule editor), Stow Profiles (the set manager) and Settings. Only real containers (backpacks, mining bags, boxes, crates) are assignable. Assigning a profile can auto-rename the bag to match (multiplayer-safe, toggleable). Four shipped sets: By Printer, By Category, Stationpedia Ascended, and Starter. Share your own sets as a compact code (clipboard) or a drop-in XML file. New "UIA class" rule type for smarter, mod-aware catches. Profile and set rename/duplicate/delete finally exist in F10. Loadouts are retired in favor of this [*] F9 STYLE PARITY: every per-element style page now mirrors the F9 global menu exactly (Glass / Edges / Glow / Bloom / Alerts / Transitions) -- one name, one range, everywhere. Each style category (Theme/Glass/Edges/Glow/Transitions) gets its own "follow global" checkbox, and unchecking one changes nothing until you actually edit it. New: make an element INHERIT its style from another element you pick by clicking it, either live-linked or as a one-time copy. Shared-global settings you couldn't reach before now show their real value with a jump-to-F9 button [*] CUT (CHAMFERED) CORNERS: a new corner style alongside rounded -- global or per element, per suit tier, travels with your theme. Full glass effects (frost, chroma, halo, shine) now render identically on cut and rounded corners [*] DETAILED VITALS TOOLTIPS: hover the vitals panel (or the vanilla stats panel) for exact mood/hygiene percentages and per-minute trend rates [*] FROM THE PARALLEL WORK LINE: device internals (drills, tablets, canisters, demo charges) now open in our own themed, resizable window with the device's real switches inside instead of the vanilla popup. A first-run tutorial walks new players through the controls (replayable from the Guide tab), with a pause button for solo games and an in-game Designer Handbook for F9. The Universal Inventory and pinned bags grew a real scrollbar. Hand-box drag-outs, inventory tooltips and 1-6 click-to-pin all had rough edges fixed. F10's "Profiles" tab is renamed "HUD Themes" and "the Grid" is now "Universal Inventory" throughout, to stop it colliding with the new Bag/Stow Profiles [*] RADIAL SIMPLIFICATION: the Hub is now the only interaction model (the old control-scheme choice and per-wheel on/off toggles are gone -- radials are core now); "flick to commit" is removed, fixing wedges that used to fire without the ring appearing [*] Fixes: world-item drops now swap into occupied wedges/boxes/slots like vanilla; F9 correctly previews the Suited HUD when authoring unpowered; separating an element's style no longer strips its frost/glow/edge light; edge-light now fully turns off with the edge masters instead of leaving a static rim; portrait ring and body-doll outline restored; F10 scrollbar crash and drag-hijack fixed; compatibility fix for a renamed internal game API [/list] [h3]Version 0.9.2.5 EXPERIMENTAL — YOUR HUD, YOUR RULES: PER-SUIT STYLES + TOTAL THEMES:[/h3] [list] [*] STYLE EVERY ELEMENT PER SUIT MODE: any HUD element can now fork its ENTIRE look between bare and suited (colours, glass, effects, icon tint — all of it, not just two colours). Turn the fork on for an element in the F9 designer and edit each mode independently; everything remembers and round-trips. The old system silently leaked most settings between modes — fixed at the root [*] THEMES NOW CARRY EVERYTHING: a saved profile's theme includes the radial menus (size, colours, effects, hint bar), the Universal Inventory skin AND the F10 Control Center skin — switch profiles and the whole mod retints as one. Performance settings deliberately stay global (a theme carries a look, not a framerate). Your current look is stamped into your existing profiles on first launch, so nothing changes until you want it to [*] REAL PROFILE MANAGEMENT: New (blank slate), Duplicate, Rename, Delete (with confirm, never the active one) and "Restore shipped version" — in F9 and the F10 Profiles tab. Break a shipped theme? Restore it in one click, or delete it and a pristine copy returns next launch [*] THE F9 DESIGNER, REORGANIZED: the Effects wall of dropdowns is now clean sub-tabs (Glass / Edges / Glow / Bloom / Alerts / Transitions / Advanced), the Theme tab leads with the palette wheels, jargon got plain names, the active tab and the suit mode you are editing are clearly marked, and long profile names no longer get cut off [*] TINT ITEM ICONS is now per-element too: keep the global switch, or give any element its own tint colour (or none) — separately per suit mode [*] SPRING CLEANING: the pre-0.9 legacy HUD, the old fixed-panel HUD and the old ImGui radial renderer are gone — the document-driven HUD IS the mod now. Your config is migrated automatically (dead settings cleaned out, old glitch settings carried over) [*] SAFETY NET: a corrupt profile is quarantined to a .broken backup instead of being overwritten; "uiareset" console command + an F10 "Restore shipped themes" button give you a clean-slate path without hunting folders [*] Plus: the F10 menu now fully matches Pure HUD (and every theme) including its border and dividers; the radial accent colour is themeable (and still orange by default) [/list] [i]Full version history (0.9.2.0 and earlier) is in CHANGELOG.md, in the mod folder and on GitHub.[/i]
